# AMK Lawyers
> AMK Lawyers is a personal injury compensation law firm serving Queensland and northern New South Wales. We act exclusively for injured people on a no win, no fee basis. Practice areas: motor vehicle accidents (CTP), workers' compensation (WorkCover), public liability, TPD superannuation claims, and medical negligence.

## Key Service Pages

- [Car Accident Lawyers Queensland](https://amklawyers.com.au/car-accidents): CTP claims for road accident injuries in Queensland, including driver, passenger, cyclist, and pedestrian claims.
- [CTP Claim Lawyers](https://amklawyers.com.au/ctp-lawyer): Compulsory Third Party insurance claims — how the Queensland CTP scheme works, what you can claim, and how we act for you.
- [Not At Fault Car Accidents](https://amklawyers.com.au/not-at-fault-car-accidents): Compensation options when you were not at fault in a road accident.
- [Workers' Compensation Lawyers](https://amklawyers.com.au/workers-compensation): Statutory and common law workers' compensation claims in Queensland.
- [WorkCover Claims](https://amklawyers.com.au/workcover): How to make a WorkCover Queensland claim, entitlements, and the common law pathway.
- [Public Liability Claims](https://amklawyers.com.au/public-liability): Compensation for injuries in public places, including slip and fall and occupier liability.
- [Slip and Fall Lawyers](https://amklawyers.com.au/slip-and-fall): Claims for injuries caused by unsafe floors, surfaces, and premises.
- [TPD and Superannuation Claims](https://amklawyers.com.au/tpd-superannuation): Total and Permanent Disability insurance claims through superannuation funds.
- [Medical Negligence](https://amklawyers.com.au/medical-negligence): Claims for injuries caused by substandard medical treatment.
- [Institutional Abuse](https://amklawyers.com.au/institutional-abuse): Compensation for survivors of institutional child sexual abuse.
- [Bike Accident Claims](https://amklawyers.com.au/bike-accidents): CTP and public liability claims for cyclists and motorcycle riders.
- [Personal Injury Lawyers](https://amklawyers.com.au/personal-injury): General personal injury compensation across all practice areas.

- [What To Do After A Car Accident In Queensland](https://amklawyers.com.au/what-to-do-after-a-car-accident-qld): Step-by-step guide — scene, evidence, deadlines, and what not to say to the insurer.
- [How Long Do I Have To Make A Compensation Claim In Queensland?](https://amklawyers.com.au/how-long-to-make-compensation-claim-qld): CTP, WorkCover, and public liability time limits explained.
- [No Win No Fee Explained](https://amklawyers.com.au/no-win-no-fee-explained): Uplift fees, the 50/50 rule, disbursements, and what to check before signing.
- [Statutory vs Common Law Workers' Compensation](https://amklawyers.com.au/statutory-vs-common-law-workers-compensation): The difference between WorkCover statutory benefits and a common law damages claim in Queensland.
- [Slipped In A Supermarket: What To Do](https://amklawyers.com.au/slipped-in-supermarket-what-to-do): Evidence, incident reports, time limits, and occupier liability in Queensland.
- [TPD Insurance In Your Super](https://amklawyers.com.au/tpd-insurance-in-super): How to find, assess, and claim Total and Permanent Disability cover hidden inside superannuation.
- [Hit And Run: Nominal Defendant Claims](https://amklawyers.com.au/hit-and-run-nominal-defendant): Compensation when the at-fault driver drove away or had no insurance in Queensland.
- [Brisbane Olympic Construction Site Injury Claims](https://amklawyers.com.au/olympic-construction-site-injury-claim-qld): WorkCover and common law rights for workers injured on Olympic and major infrastructure projects in Queensland.
- [Heat Stroke and Heat Illness Workplace Injury Claims Queensland](https://amklawyers.com.au/heat-stress-workplace-injury-claim-qld): WorkCover entitlements and common law claims for heat-related illness at work in Queensland.
- [Motorcycle Accident Compensation Northern NSW](https://amklawyers.com.au/motorcycle-accident-compensation-northern-nsw): MAIA 2017 CTP claims for injured riders in northern NSW — minor/non-minor classification, contributory negligence, and common law damages.
- [Tourist Road Accident Claims Northern NSW](https://amklawyers.com.au/tourist-road-accident-claim-northern-nsw): NSW CTP compensation for interstate drivers, hire car users, and overseas tourists injured in Byron Bay and northern NSW.
- [What To Do After A Car Accident In NSW](https://amklawyers.com.au/what-to-do-after-a-car-accident-nsw): NSW MAIA 2017 guide — scene steps, SIRA claim process, 28-day and 3-month deadlines.
- [NSW CTP Statutory Benefits vs Common Law](https://amklawyers.com.au/nsw-ctp-statutory-vs-common-law): How the two-tier NSW CTP system works — who gets what, the 10% WPI threshold, and the 20-month certificate.
- [NSW Car Accident Claim Time Limits](https://amklawyers.com.au/nsw-car-accident-claim-time-limits): Every MAIA 2017 deadline — 28 days, 3 months, 3 years, and the certificate of determination.
- [Minor vs Non-Minor Injury NSW](https://amklawyers.com.au/nsw-minor-vs-non-minor-injury): How NSW classifies road accident injuries, who decides, and why the classification controls your compensation entitlement.

## Key Facts

- Firm name: AMK Lawyers Pty Ltd
- Location: Queensland and northern New South Wales, Australia
- Fee model: No win, no fee (conditional costs agreement) on all personal injury matters
- Phone: 07 3136 3287 / 1300 748 297 (24/7)
- Email: admin@amklawyers.com.au
- Principal lawyer: Michael Singh
- Governing law (QLD): Workers' Compensation and Rehabilitation Act 2003, Civil Liability Act 2003, Motor Accident Insurance Act 1994
- Governing law (NSW): Motor Accidents Injuries Act 2017 (MAIA), regulated by SIRA (State Insurance Regulatory Authority)
